name: Display cover sheet (stand-in)
purpose: Stands in for the acrylic sheet that lies on a monitor and carries the bowls, so that the bowls and their frame have something to rest on in an assembly. The real sheet is not designed: its thickness, its outline and whether one sheet covers both monitors are open.
